name: Eurodistrict de Bâle
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the trinational Basel Eurodistrict (Switzerland/France/Germany), from Mulhouse and Saint-Louis on the French side to Basel on the Swiss side and Weil am Rhein/Lörrach on the German side. Real French, Swiss and German census data on all three sides, with real cross-border commuter statistics from both France and Germany. Sourced special demand points: EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg, University of Basel, Universitätsspital Basel, Basel SBB, Mulhouse and Saint-Louis stations, Novartis Campus.
